entries.title: Psalms 89:1
segments: ¶<<A Contemplation of Ethan the Ezrahite.>> I will sing of the mercies of the LORD forever; With my mouth will I make known Your faithfulness to all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 89:2
segments: For I have said, "Mercy shall be built up forever; Your faithfulness You shall establish in the very heavens."

entries.title: Psalms 89:3
segments: "I have made a covenant with My chosen, I have sworn to My servant David:

entries.title: Psalms 89:4
segments: 'Your seed I will establish forever, And build up your throne to all generations.'" Selah

entries.title: Psalms 89:5
segments: ¶And the heavens will praise Your wonders, O LORD; Your faithfulness also in the assembly of the saints.

entries.title: Psalms 89:6
segments: For who in the heavens can be compared to the LORD? [Who] among the sons of the mighty can be likened to the LORD?

entries.title: Psalms 89:7
segments: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, And to be held in reverence by all [those] around Him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:8
segments: O LORD God of hosts, Who [is] mighty like You, O LORD? Your faithfulness also surrounds You.

entries.title: Psalms 89:9
segments: You rule the raging of the sea; When its waves rise, You still them.

entries.title: Psalms 89:10
segments: You have broken Rahab in pieces, as one who is slain; You have scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.

entries.title: Psalms 89:11
segments: The heavens [are] Yours, the earth also [is] Yours; The world and all its fullness, You have founded them.

entries.title: Psalms 89:12
segments: The north and the south, You have created them; Tabor and Hermon rejoice in Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 89:13
segments: You have a mighty arm; Strong is Your hand, [and] high is Your right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 89:14
segments: Righteousness and justice [are] the foundation of Your throne; Mercy and truth go before Your face.

entries.title: Psalms 89:15
segments: ¶Blessed [are] the people who know the joyful sound! They walk, O LORD, in the light of Your countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 89:16
segments: In Your name they rejoice all day long, And in Your righteousness they are exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 89:17
segments: For You [are] the glory of their strength, And in Your favor our horn is exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 89:18
segments: For our shield [belongs] to the LORD, And our king to the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 89:19
segments: ¶Then You spoke in a vision to Your holy one, And said: "I have given help to [one who is] mighty; I have exalted one chosen from the people.

entries.title: Psalms 89:20
segments: I have found My servant David; With My holy oil I have anointed him,

entries.title: Psalms 89:21
segments: With whom My hand shall be established; Also My arm shall strengthen him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:22
segments: The enemy shall not outwit him, Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:23
segments: I will beat down his foes before his face, And plague those who hate him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:24
segments: "But My faithfulness and My mercy [shall be] with him, And in My name his horn shall be exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 89:25
segments: Also I will set his hand over the sea, And his right hand over the rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 89:26
segments: He shall cry to Me, 'You [are] my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.'

entries.title: Psalms 89:27
segments: Also I will make him [My] firstborn, The highest of the kings of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 89:28
segments: My mercy I will keep for him forever, And My covenant shall stand firm with him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:29
segments: His seed also I will make [to endure] forever, And his throne as the days of heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 89:30
segments: "If his sons forsake My law And do not walk in My judgments,

entries.title: Psalms 89:31
segments: If they break My statutes And do not keep My commandments,

entries.title: Psalms 89:32
segments: Then I will punish their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.

entries.title: Psalms 89:33
segments: Nevertheless My lovingkindness I will not utterly take from him, Nor allow My faithfulness to fail.

entries.title: Psalms 89:34
segments: My covenant I will not break, Nor alter the word that has gone out of My lips.

entries.title: Psalms 89:35
segments: Once I have sworn by My holiness; I will not lie to David:

entries.title: Psalms 89:36
segments: His seed shall endure forever, And his throne as the sun before Me;

entries.title: Psalms 89:37
segments: It shall be established forever like the moon, Even [like] the faithful witness in the sky." Selah

entries.title: Psalms 89:38
segments: ¶But You have cast off and abhorred, You have been furious with Your anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 89:39
segments: You have renounced the covenant of Your servant; You have profaned his crown [by casting it] to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 89:40
segments: You have broken down all his hedges; You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

entries.title: Psalms 89:41
segments: All who pass by the way plunder him; He is a reproach to his neighbors.

entries.title: Psalms 89:42
segments: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries; You have made all his enemies rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 89:43
segments: You have also turned back the edge of his sword, And have not sustained him in the battle.

entries.title: Psalms 89:44
segments: You have made his glory cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 89:45
segments: The days of his youth You have shortened; You have covered him with shame. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 89:46
segments: How long, LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath burn like fire?

entries.title: Psalms 89:47
segments: Remember how short my time is; For what futility have You created all the children of men?

entries.title: Psalms 89:48
segments: What man can live and not see death? Can he deliver his life from the power of the grave? Selah

entries.title: Psalms 89:49
segments: Lord, where [are] Your former lovingkindnesses, [Which] You swore to David in Your truth?

entries.title: Psalms 89:50
segments: Remember, Lord, the reproach of Your servants-[How] I bear in my bosom [the reproach of] all the many peoples,

entries.title: Psalms 89:51
segments: With which Your enemies have reproached, O LORD, With which they have reproached the footsteps of Your anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 89:52
segments: Blessed [be] the LORD forevermore! Amen and Amen.
